# Overview

**Treeliable: Smash the Ore** is an addon for Treeliable, that adds 3^3 vein mining. A purpose of the mod is to simplify the grinding part of mining, the same as it does Treeliable with trees, without any new enchantments or items.
### Dependecies
- [Treeliable](https://modrinth.com/mod/treeliable)
- [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)
## Features
> **Vein mining:** 3^3 blocks ore mining, that works only with pickaxes. *Can be set to break blocks by layers, or by blocks.*
